description: Job Title: Business Analyst/QA Specialist Job Description The Business Analyst/QA Specialist plays a key role in translating business, user, and product needs into clear, actionable requirements that support software and platform development in a complex, compliance-driven environment. This position partners closely with product, engineering, and quality assurance teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and fully traceable across the system lifecycle. Responsibilities Elicit, analyze, and document business, user, and product requirements that capture functional, non-functional, and compliance-related needs. Partner with Product Owners, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and interconnected across systems. Analyze how requirements impact one another and identify dependencies, constraints, and interactions within integrated system components. Ensure compliance-driven and policy-related requirements are accurately reflected and traceable throughout the system lifecycle. Support QA processes by linking requirements to test cases and validation criteria to achieve complete coverage and end-to-end traceability. Maintain organized, high-quality documentation across Jira, Confluence, and related collaboration and tracking tools. Facilitate requirement review sessions to confirm accuracy, resolve ambiguities, and promote shared understanding across delivery teams. Interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies to inform requirement design and impact analysis. Collaborate with stakeholders from both technical and business domains to align requirements with strategic objectives and user needs. Essential Skills Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst supporting software or platform development. Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience in requirements gathering and documentation across business, user, and product domains. Strong understanding of how business, user, and product requirements interrelate within complex system environments. Technical fluency sufficient to interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies. Experience supporting QA workflows and maintaining requirements-to-test-case traceability. Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to break down complex problems and define clear, structured requirements. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences and facilitate collaborative discussions. Ability to ensure compliance and security-related requirements are incorporated into system design and documentation. Additional Skills & Qualifications Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements management, documentation, and collaboration. Experience supporting government programs or compliance-driven software delivery initiatives. Knowledge of NIST standards, FedRAMP

Job Title: PLM Analyst Job Description The PLM Analyst performs asbestos analysis and environmental sample testing in a highly regulated laboratory environment governed by EPA regulations and guidelines. This role offers the opportunity to accelerate your career in a specialized industry by working with advanced microscopy techniques and contributing to accurate, timely results for a high volume of samples. Responsibilities Conduct asbestos analysis with rapid turnaround times while maintaining high accuracy in a highly regulated environment. Prepare and analyze environmental samples of air and bulk materials using polarized light microscopy (PLM) and phase contrast microscopy (PCM). Record and deliver accurate analytical results into the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Assist with general clerical tasks and laboratory duties as needed to support overall lab operations. Perform quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) practices in accordance with company policies to ensure consistent and reliable test results. Participate in regular calibration activities with other analysts, recognizing that tests are subjective and require ongoing alignment of interpretation. Support high sample volumes by focusing on timely processing and analysis, particularly during peak workloads. Cross-train in multiple laboratory areas as required, while maintaining primary responsibility for relieving high volumes of PLM and related samples. Collaborate closely with other PLM Analysts to review QC samples, discuss findings, and maintain consistent testing standards. Essential Skills Hands-on experience with polarized light microscopy (PLM) for analysis of environmental samples. Hands-on experience with phase contrast microscopy (PCM) for analysis of air and bulk samples. Familiarity with asbestos analysis and related regulatory requirements. Background in biology or geology, with the ability to interpret sample structures and compositions. Previous laboratory experience of 13 years, which may include academic lab work. Ability to work accurately and efficiently under time pressure and high sample volumes. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering precise and reliable results. Ability to follow detailed QA/QC procedures and maintain consistent testing practices. Comfort using a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) to document and manage results. Effective communication skills to interact frequently with other analysts for QC and calibration activities. Additional Skills & Qualifications Associate or Bachelors degree in Geology or Biology preferred. Experience working with microscopes in a laboratory setting. Familiarity with environmental testing methods governed by EPA regulations and guidelines. Ability to adapt to cross-training in multiple laboratory areas. Job Title: GIS Analyst 3 Job Description The GIS Analyst 3 supports GIS data management, spatial analysis, and process improvement initiatives in a utility-focused environment. This role involves analyzing spatial and tabular data, performing data conversions and migrations, maintaining GIS databases, and developing solutions for data integrations and transformations. The analyst conducts advanced GIS analysis, QA/QC, application testing, reporting, map creation, and automation using tools such as ArcGIS Pro, Model Builder, and Python. The position works closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs, improve workflows, and support highly visible utility GIS initiatives. Responsibilities Edit, update, and maintain GIS data to ensure accuracy and completeness. Perform GIS data analysis and data mining to support utility and pipeline projects. Process and convert spatial and tabular data into GIS formats suitable for enterprise use. Conduct QA/QC on GIS datasets prior to production and distribution. Support ongoing GIS database maintenance, including data models and structures. Create specialized queries, maps, and reports tailored to business and project needs. Analyze existing GIS-related processes and recommend improvements and modernization efforts. Support application testing, documentation, and validation of GIS tools and workflows. Work independently on multiple concurrent GIS assignments and projects. Apply linear referencing systems (LRS) to accurately locate and manage pipeline and utility assets along linear features. Develop and maintain Python scripts and/or Model Builder workflows to automate GIS tasks. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and GIS teams to support cross-functional initiatives. Contribute to the implementation and use of Utility and Pipeline Data Model (UPDM), Utility Network, and ArcGIS Enterprise solutions. Use tools such as FME, SQL databases, AutoCAD/CADD, SharePoint, and Visual Basic/VBA to support integrations and data management. Participate in process improvement discussions and help influence modernization of GIS practices. Essential Skills Advanced proficiency with ArcGIS Pro for editing, analysis, and map production. Strong understanding and practical experience with Linear Referencing Systems (LRS), including locating assets based on stationing or distance measures along linear features. Hands-on experience performing GIS data analysis, QA/QC, and database maintenance. Proficiency in Python scripting and/or ArcGIS Model Builder for automation of GIS workflows. 1+ year supporting utility or pipeline GIS environments. Job Title: Lab Research Analyst I Job Description The Lab Research Analyst I is a hands-on laboratory scientist who supports the development of new vaccines and therapeutics by studying immune responses through complex bench experiments, detailed sample analysis, and rigorous data generation. This role focuses on high-throughput molecular biology and immunology workflows, working with human and animal samples to evaluate antibody responses and contribute directly to mission-driven research with global impact. Responsibilities Receive and process human, macaque, and mouse samples from vaccine studies and clinical trials, ensuring careful handling and preservation of sample integrity. Isolate, enrich, culture, and sequence B cells to evaluate antibody responses following immunization, using established protocols and high-throughput workflows. Perform cell culture work, including maintaining primary cell cultures and ensuring optimal growth conditions and sterility. Conduct molecular biology techniques such as nucleic acid extraction, RNA extraction, RT-PCR, PCR, qPCR, and preparation of samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS). Execute single-cell B-cell isolation and antibody gene sequencing workflows involving thousands of individual cell samples, maintaining accuracy and consistency across large datasets. Run immunological assays including ELISA, bead-based immunoassays, immunofluorescence staining, and microscopy-based analyses to characterize immune responses. Utilize flow cytometry for cell sorting and analysis, and perform data analysis using tools such as FlowJo and GraphPad Prism where applicable. Support recombinant antibody production, purification, and quality control activities to ensure reliable and reproducible antibody reagents. Maintain detailed and accurate experimental documentation, following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and laboratory quality standards at all times. Collaborate closely with scientists, laboratory leadership, and support staff to meet project milestones and regulatory deadlines, including those related to federal agencies. Assist with general laboratory maintenance, including equipment upkeep, reagent preparation, inventory management, and supply tracking. Execute highly detailed, repetitive laboratory workflows with precision, ensuring that fragile biological samples are handled carefully and that protocols are followed consistently to prevent contamination or compromised sequencing results. Work effectively within a research environment that utilizes advanced robotics and sequencing equipment, safeguarding data integrity throughout the experimental process. Essential Skills Minimum of 2 years of laboratory research experience within an academic setting (a Masters degree may substitute for this experience). Bachelors or advanced degree in Biology, Immunology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Zoology, Botany, Psychology, or a related scientific discipline. Hands-on experience with high-throughput mol

description: Job Title: Parts Data Management Analyst II - Product Engineering Support Job Description The Parts Data Management Analyst II supports product engineering and manufacturing operations in a complex manufacturing environment by creating, maintaining, and analyzing Bills of Materials (BOMs), product structures, and engineering parts data. This role ensures that product and parts information is accurate, controlled, and properly implemented throughout the product lifecycle, with a strong focus on new product introductions and ongoing product changes. The analyst partners closely with engineering and operations teams to maintain data integrity, support engineering changes, and enable informed product and manufacturing decisions. Responsibilities Create, maintain, and analyze Bills of Materials (BOMs) and product structures for existing products and new product introductions. Manage, validate, and update part and product data received from product design, manufacturing engineering, and other engineering teams. Support new product introductions and product updates by ensuring BOM and parts data are accurate, complete, and correctly implemented into systems. Process and support engineering changes, including ECOs, ECNs, ECRs, or similar change-control workflows, and ensure changes are properly reflected in BOMs and product structures. Work within PLM, PDM, ERP, or similar engineering data-management systems to maintain accurate engineering product information and material master data. Identify discrepancies, missing information, and errors within BOMs, product structures, and parts data, and coordinate corrections with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders. Analyze engineering and product data and prepare reports that support product, engineering, and manufacturing decisions. Partner cross-functionally with product engineering, design engineering, manufacturing engineering, operations, and other stakeholders to align on product structures and data requirements. Maintain accurate technical documentation, including part records, product structures, and engineering documentation, while following established engineering data-management processes and standards. Support process improvement initiatives related to product data, BOM management, engineering workflows, and configuration management. Understand and apply parent/child part relationships and complex product structures to ensure accurate representation of assemblies and components. Support manufacturing launches and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities by ensuring product data and BOMs are ready, validated, and aligned with production needs. Use Microsoft Excel and other tools to analyze, organize, validate, and report on large volumes of product and parts data. Manage multiple priorities effectively while working independently and ensuring timely completion of data-management tasks. Essential Skills At least 2+ years of experience working with Bills of Materials (BOMs), product structures

Job Title: QC Microbiology Analyst Job Description The QC Microbiology Analyst performs essential microbiological analyses that ensure product quality and safety within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. In this role, you conduct microbiological testing on raw materials, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with established SOPs and GMP guidelines. You prepare media, maintain cultures, identify microorganisms, perform environmental monitoring, and calibrate laboratory equipment while carefully documenting and analyzing test results. You also contribute to method development, support validation projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement in laboratory and quality operations. This position offers strong career development opportunities, exposure to multiple areas of pharmaceutical quality, and the chance to directly support a mission focused on making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Responsibilities Perform microbiological testing on raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and environmental samples in accordance with SOPs, GMP, and GLP requirements. Prepare microbiological media and reagents, ensuring accurate formulation, labeling, and sterility. Maintain and handle microbial cultures, including storage, subculturing, and disposal in line with aseptic techniques and safety protocols. Conduct environmental monitoring activities, including sampling of air, surfaces, and personnel, and interpret results against established limits. Execute microbiological assays such as growth promotion testing and microbial identification using approved methods. Calibrate, operate, and perform routine maintenance on laboratory equipment to ensure reliable and accurate test results. Document all laboratory activities and test results clearly and accurately in laboratory notebooks, electronic systems, and quality records. Analyze data, identify trends or deviations, and escalate issues in accordance with quality and compliance procedures. Participate in method development and validation projects to improve or implement microbiological testing procedures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Quality Control, Materials Testing, Sampling, Instrument Maintenance, Microbiology, and Research and Development to support overall quality objectives. Support continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory by suggesting process enhancements and contributing to problem-solving efforts. Follow all safety protocols and use appropriate personal protective equipment, including lab coat, safety glasses, and gloves, while performing laboratory tasks. Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant laboratory workspace that meets regulatory and internal quality standards. Manage workload effectively by prioritizing testing activities to meet project timelines and production schedules. Work independently on assigned tasks while contributing positively to a collaborative team environmen

Ensure compliance with internal standards and industry regulations in all analysis deliverables so that solutions are secure ethical and aligned to societal expectations. Contribute to knowledge sharing by creating reusable templates guidelines and best practice documentation that strengthen the business analysis capability across the company. Partner with business and technology teams to ensure that implemented solutions improve customer and employee experiences and positively impact broader communities. About Cognizant Workday Cognizant Workday practice is recruiting for upcoming graduates who are looking for an exciting, entry level consulting opportunity starting in the summer of 2027. Frequently update your project lead, manager, and Engagement Manager on timelines, tasks, risks, responsibilities, tenant management, and data conversion. Stay current on Workday updates and project changes, and proactively seek opportunities to grow your skills. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you must have to be considered Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, MIS, or a related field. Strong Excel competency, including formulas, pivot tables, and ASAP Utilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively manage customer expectations. Ability to work well individually and in a team environment, with willingness to travel to customer sites when needed. These will help you succeed Knowledge of Workday. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. We’re shifting the industry from cost takeout to driving revenue growth, and from traditional outsourcing to AI-powered reinvention of the enterprise. We drive outcomes through autonomous, adaptive operations that are powered by agentic AI and built for business impact. What you’ll learn Hands-on training in AI-powered business analysis and consulting methodology. Exposure to enterprise clients and real-world business problems from day one. Mentorship from senior consultants as you build client-facing and technical skills. Responsibilities Analyze business processes, requirements, and operational data to identify improvement opportunities and support strategic decision-making. Use AI tools like Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Codex daily to speed up research, analysis, and documentation. Perform data analysis using Excel, Power BI, SQL, and other analytics tools to generate actionable business insights. Build and refine prompts to improve the quality and consistency of AI-assisted work. Support the design and adoption of Agentic AI solutions by identifying use cases, documenting requirements, and validating business outcomes. Prepare executive-ready presentations, reports, process maps, and business recommendations for clients and stakeholders. Bring strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new AI tools and business trends. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Finance, or related field (recent grads welcome) Familiarity with Excel required; exposure to Power BI or SQL is a plus Nice-to-have: Exposure to Python, Copilot Studio, or automation tools. Hands-on experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, etc.) for schoolwork or projects. Ability to grasp business needs and assess impacts to complex business operations and systems Ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment Excellent written and verbal communication Proven capabilities in teamwork and leadership Strong interest in technology and digital modernization Self-motivated Location New hires will be hired to Cognizant offices and/or client locations in Chicago, IL or Teaneck, NJ where you will work alongside other experienced Cognizant associates delivering technology solutions. Applicants must be willing to relocate to one of these major geographic areas. While we attempt to honor candidate location preferences, business need and position availability

Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

Title: AWS Data Engineer Location: Singapore Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate end-to-end data pipelines (ingestion → transformation → serving) on Databricks and/or Snowflake, following medallion/layered architecture patterns Configure and administer workspaces/accounts — compute policies, resource sizing, environment setup, and access hierarchy — per the SDP reference architecture Implement data governance controls: catalogue and schema design, RBAC, row/column-level security, data masking, and lineage tracking Set up CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for pipeline deployment and environment promotion (dev → test → prod) Configure monitoring, telemetry, and audit logging to meet SDP's central observability and security posture requirements Support UAT, integration testing, and parallel-run validation during migration and go-live Produce handover documentation (runbooks, access lists, escalation procedures) for agency operations teams Required Technical Skills — Databricks Unity Catalog — catalogue/schema design, access control, and data lineage Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables for pipeline orchestration; Delta Lake table format Databricks SQL and cluster/workspace administration (compute policies, pools, cost management) Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) and Databricks Repos for CI/CD PySpark / Spark SQL for large-scale data transformation Working knowledge of Databricks system tables (audit logs, billing/usage, query history) for observability Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or related disciplines. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Databricks involving data pipeline development, platform administration, governance, and optimization. Required Technical Skills — Common Strong SQL and Python (PySpark or general-purpose) for data engineering Data modeling — dimensional design, star/snowflake schemas, semantic layers CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for data engineering workflows Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred) for provisioning cloud data platform resources Hands-on experience on at least one hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Understanding of data security and compliance frameworks Preferred Qualifications Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional SnowPro Core, or SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer AWS certification (e.g. AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate, Solutions Architect) and hands-on experience with AWS data services. Prior experience delivering on a regulated-sector data platform, or exposure to compliance frameworks such as IM8, is an add-on Experience working as part of a System Integrator (SI) delivery team alongside a platform Principal is an add-on #LI-CTSAPAC

job_title: Data Quality Engineer - Remote in Canada
location: Halifax,NS-6940 Mumford Rd, Nova Scotia, Canada
description: Data Quality Engineer As a Data Quality Engineer specializing in Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity at Cognizant, you will design and execute automated data validation across extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data warehouses, and data migrations. You will work with development and data engineering teams to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source and target systems. This is a full-time, remote role open only to candidates located in Canada. In this role, you will Review business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and ETL designs to identify test scenarios and prepare test plans and cases. Design and execute ETL, data warehouse, and data migration tests, including automated data validation scripts using Tosca Data Integrity. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. What you need to have to be considered 6+ years of overall experience in software testing, ETL testing, and data validation, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with clear verbal and written communication. These will help you stand out Insurance domain experience. Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Snowflake. Knowledge of data lake and big data testing. Experience with Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, Talend, or other ETL tools. Tosca Automation Certification. Why Apply? We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed.

job_title: GenAI Architect – Generative AI & Agentic AI
location: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
description: About the role: As a GenAI Architect, you will make an impact by designing and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions that accelerate business innovation and transform software engineering practices. You will be a valued member of our AI and Architecture team and collaborate closely with application engineering, cloud, data, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to bring AI solutions from concept through production deployment. In this role, you will: Architect and deliver scalable Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions for enterprise applications. Design and build AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, orchestration workflows, reusable services, APIs, and accelerators. Develop architecture patterns for prompt engineering, context management, grounding, guardrails, model evaluation, and structured outputs. Lead the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar platforms to improve developer productivity and software quality. Establish best practices for responsible AI, LLMOps, observability, security, governance, CI/CD, and production monitoring while mentoring engineering teams and driving enterprise AI standards. Work model: We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Charlotte, NC. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered: 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, application architecture, software engineering, AI/ML, or related technology disciplines. Hands-on experience architecting and delivering enterprise Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Proven experience building AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions, and LLM-powered workflows. Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. Experience with AWS cloud services, preferably Amazon Bedrock, and cloud-native application architectures. Expertise with APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and distributed systems. Strong understanding of AI security, responsible AI, governance, observability, and production monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams. These will help you stand out: Experience with Palantir, enterprise AI platforms, vector databases, or enterprise knowledge management platforms. Experien

Conduct literature reviews and surveillance activities to identify potential safety signals and emerging risks. Maintain accurate documentation and records to support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders. Experience in PV Case Processing.
